Sandbox_Hydrocraft_Spawn_Book_Covers_too: Give book covers when you remove the cover of a book? (Useless item)
Sandbox_Hydrocraft_Burn_Damage_tooltip: Changes the burn damage received when using the Kiln, Smelter, Blast Furnace and Industrial Furnace.
Sandbox_Hydrocraft_Animal_Starvation_too: Can farm animals starve to death?
Sandbox_Hydrocraft_Zombie_Loot_tooltip: Changes the amount of loot on dead zombies.  It does not impact on vanilla loot, just the 'extra' loot added by Hydrocraft (which includes some vanilla items).
Sandbox_Hydrocraft_LootMultiplier_toolti: Weights of loot added by Hydrocraft. 0 disables new finds; existing items and box contents are preserved. Vanilla loot is unchanged.
Sandbox_Hydrocraft_MiningSpeedMultiplier: 1 is normal speed; 2 halves extraction and sifting time. Costs and XP stay the same. Mine construction is unaffected.
Sandbox_Hydrocraft_EnableCannabis_toolti: Disables new production and related Hydrocraft loot. Existing stock, seeds, fibres and cleaning remain. Started plant/cooking processes continue; disabled harvest produce is omitted.
